overall_reason: A small literal system with no tokens: four text colours, one 3px radius, one shadow and spacing on a 5 and 10px base hold across the page; the drift is link and label text at 13, 14 and 15px.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY and T-SCALE-FIT pass on colour, radius and spacing; T-DRIFT-PAIRS fails on small text sizes 1px apart (TOK-010).

findings.where: header toolbar, main nav and sidebar, 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: Link text runs at three sizes 1px apart: the toolbar 'Register' and 'Sign In' are 13px, the main nav 'About' to 'Sponsor' 14px, and the sidebar project titles such as 'On Upward Mobility' 15px; the article body is 16px (values.1440.font_size near_duplicates 13/14, 14/15, 15/16).
findings.before: 13, 14, 15 and 16px for link and body text
findings.after: Two steps: 14px for navigation and labels, 16px for titles and body
findings.why: Four sizes 1px apart blur the line between navigation, labels and content.

findings.evidence: Spacing sits on a 5px base (share 0.811 against chance 0.25), but 6px list padding (9 elements), 12px toolbar padding (4) and 64px nav padding (7) sit off it (values.1440.spacing).
findings.why: A few values off the base are where the next spacing scale starts.

strengths: Colour is four values: ink #353635, muted #878787, white and the purple accent #82368c.
One radius (3px) and one shadow serve every card and button.
Most spacing reuses 10, 20 and 40px on one 5px base. The sweep's 4px reading (off_scale_spacing) is not this page's scale.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
T-HARDCODE, T-TOKEN-TIERS: no custom properties; the literals are the system
the embedded project image (The Pudding) and related-project thumbnails are exhibits
